# stb

Sean Barrett's single-file public domain libraries, vendored unchanged.

- `stb_image.h` v2.30, JPEG and PNG decoding, in place of SDL_image
- `stb_truetype.h` v1.26, TrueType glyph rasterising, in place of SDL_ttf
- `stb_image_write.h`, PNG encoding for screenshots

Compiled into the Xbox 360 and original Xbox builds. The Wii U and desktop
builds use SDL_image and SDL_ttf.
